gauge.note: Measurement windows are the accumulator's reading times (about :43 past each hour). Radar put the shower over the point about 11:20-11:45 AM, so most of it falls in the 10:43-11:43 window. The 0.01" can't be split within that hour; KSFO (about 15 km away) reported light rain earlier, 10:38-11:14 AM, while radar showed no echo over the point before 11:20.
